name: OpenAPI
label: OpenAPI 3 invoke
description: Generic HTTP GET stub via OfficialApiNode (not an OpenAPI parser). Docs: https://spec.openapis.org/oas/latest.html. Operations: import_spec and list_operations GET /{spec_path}; invoke GET /{path} only — methods beyond GET are not selectable. Default baseUrl https://example.com. Auth secret auth_token is instance config only (never on INPUT, never logged). Failures are output.error. JDK HTTP.
author: 5c8b0d45-1d10-4f2e-844c-2318af96b2fa

ports.name: input
ports.description: Per-operation fields. Do not put secrets here. Path params such as id match api_spec.json placeholders.

schema.label: operation
schema.description: Which official API call to run. EXACT values: import_spec | list_operations | invoke. Prefer the instance config operation select. listen/trigger are ingress: they do not call HTTP — use a BPMN message event. Example: 'import_spec'.

schema.label: spec_path
schema.description: Path or URL segment of an OpenAPI document for import_spec / list_operations. Example: openapi.json.

schema.label: method
schema.description: HTTP method for invoke. EXACT: GET | POST | PUT | PATCH | DELETE. Default GET.

schema.label: body
schema.description: JSON request body for invoke when method is not GET/HEAD. Example: {"name":"Rex"}.

ports.name: output
ports.description: Success {status:ok, http_status, data}. Errors raise a BPMN error for the error boundary event (INVALID_INPUT, AUTH_FAILED, RATE_LIMITED, HTTP_<status>, REQUEST_FAILED); secrets are redacted.

schema.label: Status
schema.description: Exact ok on HTTP 2xx. Absent on failure.

schema.label: Data
schema.description: Parsed JSON body from the official API, or raw text.

configurationParameters.label: Operation
configurationParameters.description: Official API operation. EXACT: import_spec, list_operations, invoke. listen is BPMN ingress, not a socket.

configurationParameters.label: Auth Token
configurationParameters.description: Optional passthrough bearer for invoke. Leave unused for public specs.

configurationParameters.label: Timeout (seconds)
configurationParameters.description: Connect + read timeout. Default 25. Keep at or below the daemon stateful budget (~300s).

configurationParameters.label: Method
configurationParameters.description: HTTP method for invoke. EXACT: GET | POST | PUT | PATCH | DELETE. Default GET.

configurationParameters.label: Body
configurationParameters.description: JSON request body for invoke when method is not GET/HEAD. Example: {"name":"Rex"}.
